title: SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials
abstract: arXiv:2610.00050v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. translated_title: SW-KAN：采用Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络
translated_abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）代表了深度学习领域的一次范式转变，它用边上的可学习一元函数取代固定的节点激活函数，提供了更强的可解释性和参数效率。虽然近期基于多项式的KAN变体已经解决了原始B样条实现的计算开销问题，但它们引入了一个根本性却未被充分探索的挑战：无界实值输入与正交多项式基的有界或半无限支撑域之间的定义域不匹配问题。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（SW-KAN），这是一种新颖的架构，采用定义在半无限域(0, +∞)上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式。我们引入了一种平滑的tanh指数映射，在保持良好梯度条件的同时稳定地弥合了定义域差距，并利用了数值稳定的三项递推关系。
tldr: 提出SW-KAN，一种采用定义在半无限域上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式并结合平滑tanh指数映射的新型KAN架构，有效解决了无界输入与正交多项式基之间的定义域不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: SW-KAN is a novel Kolmogorov-Arnold Network architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials on the semi-infinite domain with a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping, addressing the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and orthogonal polynomial bases.
